blocks.text: Silver Valley homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Silver Valley, September 2026. Detached houses: 49 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 10% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 15 listed at month end and 0 sold in September, a sales ratio of —.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 29 over 4 months against an average of 55.0 listed, about 7.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 13 sold. condos and townhomes sold 10 over 4 months against an average of 13.2 listed, about 5.3 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 5 sold.
